name: Close Quarters (6-Day)
environment: Home — dumbbells and an adjustable bench
description: Twelve weeks of push, pull and legs twice a week, built entirely from a pair of dumbbells and a bench. Nothing here needs a rack, a cable or a machine, so it runs in a spare room, a garage or a hotel gym that only got the basics right. Six days is what makes the volume work without any one session running long. Weeks 4 and 11 back off; week 12 is the most work in the block.
goals: Build muscle with dumbbells alone, wherever you train
Train every muscle group twice a week for twelve weeks
Hold six short sessions instead of four long ones
Progress by adding reps and sets, not by buying heavier weights
Come back off two deload weeks stronger than you went into them
